title: GoPro project.yaml
description: Configuration for the gopro build tool. Print the schema for the installed gopro with `gopro schema`. Cross-references (a listed name that nothing defines, a $name base) are checked by gopro itself when it loads the file.

product.description: Product name; also the prefix GetEnvKey gives environment variable names.

version.description: Product version; falls back to the Git tag.

module.description: Go module path; read from the go.mod beside project.yaml when unset. gopro init needs one of the two.

env.description: Named environments, selected with -e. Each is merged over default per key; a list it sets replaces default's whole.

name.description: Component name: a single path element, since it names files and directories.

files.description: Glob patterns of the files to process; unset processes every file. A pattern without / matches by base name at any depth. A file named secret.env is never written to output.

config_tgt.description: Config output directory; unset renders in place, beside the templates.

configs.description: Configs to generate, by name from generate.configs.

binary_src.description: Parent directory of binary sources; a binary builds from binary_src/<name> unless it sets src.

binary_tgt.description: Output directory for binaries; unset is the working directory.

binaries.description: Binaries to build, by name from build.binaries.

binary_build_env.description: Environment for go build, as KEY=value. A binary's build_env and a platform's env merge over it key-wise.

binary_build_args.description: go build flags. A binary's build_args or a platform's args replace them whole. -o, -X on framingo's info package and positionals are reserved.

image_build_src.description: Parent directory of Dockerfiles; an image builds from image_build_src/<name>/Dockerfile unless it sets build_src.

images.description: Images to build, by name from build.images.

image_prefix.description: Registry prefix for image references, unless an image sets its own prefix.

image_tag.description: Image tag, unless an image sets its own; defaults to latest.

image_build_env.description: Environment for docker build and docker tag, as KEY=value.

image_build_args.description: Extra docker build flags. -t, -f and the NAME, BASE, CONFIG_TGT and CONFIG_DIR build args are reserved.

kubernetes_tgt.description: Kubernetes output directory; unset renders in place.

kubernetes_templates.description: Kubernetes templates to generate, by name from generate.kubernetes.

docker_compose_tgt.description: Docker Compose output directory; unset is the working directory. Never cleared before rendering.

binaries.description: Binary definitions; an environment builds those its binaries list names.

images.description: Image definitions; an environment builds those its images list names.

version.description: The application's own version, injected as info.ApplicationVersion; defaults to the product version.

platform.description: Deprecated: use platforms. Targets as GOOS/GOARCH.

platforms.description: Cross-compile targets, each built as <name>_<GOOS>_<GOARCH> in addition to the host binary.

build_env.description: Environment for this binary, merged over binary_build_env key-wise.

build_args.description: go build flags for this binary, replacing binary_build_args whole; an explicit [] builds with none.

config_dir.description: The binary's config directory, as GetConfigDir and the CONFIG_DIR build arg give it.

platformName.description: Target as GOOS/GOARCH, such as linux/arm64.

env.description: Environment for this target only, merged over build_env key-wise.

args.description: go build flags for this target only, replacing build_args whole.

base.description: Base image, passed as the BASE build arg; $<name> refers to another image in build.images.

build_src.description: Directory holding the Dockerfile, instead of image_build_src/<name>.

build_from.description: Pull and retag this existing image instead of building a Dockerfile.

repo.description: Repository name, instead of the image name.

configs.description: Config definitions; an environment generates those its configs list names.

kubernetes.description: Kubernetes template definitions; an environment generates those its kubernetes_templates list names.
